title: Reduction of curve cohomology comparison to connected smooth curves
statement: For algebraically closed fields k subset K, a quasi-compact separated smooth curve f:C -> Spec k of relative dimension one, and natural numbers n and q, suppose the canonical cohomology pullback with constant Z/n coefficients is bijective in degree q for every connected smooth curve over k. Then it is bijective in degree q for C. The empty curve and n=0 or n=1 are included; no invertibility is needed for this component assembly.

source.place: First step: reduction by finite clopen connected components

proof.text: Use exists_smoothCurveConnectedCoproduct to obtain a finite coproduct of connected smooth curves with structure morphisms g_i. This step is fully proved from closed upstream and Mathlib theorems, including the empty case.

Use finiteCoproductCohomologyAssembly on C. Transport every restriction cohomology group along the upperStarConstantSheafIso and explicitly prove the induced H.map functions are equivalences using H.map_comp_apply and H.map_id_apply. The product of these equivalences composed with assembly is bijective; Equiv.ofBijective gives e.

Use finiteCoproductConstantBaseChangeSquare for target product coordinates eK and its coordinate equation. Apply the given h separately to each g_i. For injectivity use component injectivity, the coordinate equation and injectivity of e. For surjectivity choose a lift for each coordinate of eK(y), lift the assembled tuple through e.symm, then use the coordinate equation and injectivity of eK. This Lean proof also handles an empty index type.

theorem bijective_curve_cohomologyMap_of_connected
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed K] [Algebra k K]
    {C : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (n q : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ {D : Scheme.{u}} (g : D ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve g] [Smooth g],
      Function.Bijective (Etale.cohomologyMap
        (pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
        (D.constantZMod n) q)) :
    Function.Bijective (Etale.cohomologyMap
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
      (C.constantZMod n) q)
